note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin), fetched whole from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx) — all 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk, with section headings, Psalm acrostic letters, speaker labels and the IRV's own parenthetical cross-references stripped, so translators pasted verse bytes by script rather than retyping.

A `mined` row is an exact byte substring of the IRV of at least 45 characters (or the whole verse, when shorter), measured against the finished chapter — not a translator's claim. Short verbatim sub-spans (e.g. "परमेश्वर प्रेम है") fall below that threshold and are recorded self_rendered for the reviewer to confirm.

Translated by 14 agents working chapter ranges in parallel against one shared conventions file (fixed chapter titles, term table, straight quote marks mirroring the English), then reconciled book-wide.

Per the batch orchestrator, verified English citation/transcription slips are rendered corrected in hi (the English fix ships separately via the ko job #7664): Phil 3:20-21, 1 Cor 11:3, Matt 16:21 ("21st verse"), 1 John 2:1, Keuka, 1 Cor 12:4-6, John 8:58, Matt 14:33, 1 John 3:13-18, 2 Chr 26:16-21, the Acts 17:28 verse label, Matt 23:17, Lev 27:14, 16, Rom 10:9-10, John 3:5-6, Titus 3:5, "eighth", 1 John 5:19, Gen 3:1, Matt 12:40.
